This AVP contains either a Public- Identity AVP or an MSISDN AVP or an External-Identifier AVP.

This AVP contains an MSISDN, in international number format as described in ITU-T Rec E.164 [8], encoded as a TBCD-string, i.e. digits from 0 through 9 are encoded 0000 to 1001; 1111 is used as a filler when there is an odd number of digits; bits 8 to 5 of octet n encode digit 2n; bits 4 to 1 of octet n encode digit 2(n-1)+1.
The exact content and format of this AVP is described in 3GPP TS 29.328 [1] Annex C as Sh-Data.

element_entry.name: CallReferenceNumber
element_entry.title: a call reference number (the callReferenceNumber of SendRoutingInfoArg and ProvideRoamingNumberArg)
element_entry.unchecked: the octets take any value: the type says nothing more of them

quotes.text: The exact content and format of this AVP corresponds to the gmsc-address parameter described in 3GPP TS 29.002 [11].

element_entry.check: 1 to 9 octets; octet 1 bit 8 (extension, 1 for no extension) 1; octets 2 on TBCD digits (0-9, *, #, a, b, c), '1111' filling only the last octet's bits 8-5
element_entry.name: ISDN-AddressString
element_entry.title: an ISDN number as an AddressString: a nature of address and numbering plan octet, then TBCD digits (the gmsc-Address of ProvideRoamingNumberArg, clause 17.7.3)
element_entry.unchecked: the nature of address and numbering plan values the type marks reserved are not refused, since it does not say they are not sent
